title: Sunday · Last Bell, 2006
logline: The school at the last bell, and this year the stick-figure chorus in the back of every tier, watching the strip watch the school. The far sidewalk with a man and a dog. Nobody speaks.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the school from across the road at 3:05, the bell shape, and a row of stick figures along the bottom edge, small, watching.

image.prompt: a small-town high school seen from across a road with a jagged sound shape at the door and a row of tiny stick figures along the bottom edge watching, watercolor

panels.name: Bell

panels.composition: Tier 2: students pouring out toward the beach road, the stick chorus at the tier's bottom.

image.prompt: students pouring out of a school toward a beach road with tiny stick figures along the bottom edge of the image, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Doors

panels.composition: Tier 3: the far sidewalk, a man in a chore coat and a dog still, the stick chorus turned to look at them.

image.prompt: a man in a canvas chore coat and a dog standing on a far sidewalk while tiny stick figures along the bottom edge turn to look at them, watercolor

panels.name: Sidewalk

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving
